subject: packet-observed Oblivion Dream recipient marker and exact rDPS exclusion

packet_evidence.interpretation: The varying positive and negative current-HP deltas and the single resonance-energy spend are combat activity serialized in the same wire messages as this short-lived area marker. They are not a stable coefficient produced by the marker.

current_build_identity_evidence.description_semantics: Allies in Oblivion Dream receive 5 percent Illusion-Breaking damage reduction, increased by another 3 percent when at least three enemies are in range.
current_build_identity_evidence.purpose: Current-build rows independently identify the retained historical packet effect as a defensive recipient marker. They are not used to manufacture packet occurrence or an offensive scalar.

rdps_classification.reason: The effect reduces incoming Illusion-Breaking damage and has no packet-observed offensive attribute or target-vulnerability stage. Defensive mitigation belongs to survivability analysis, not damage transferred to the provider.
rdps_classification.retention: Every status transition, provider, recipient, current-HP update, resonance-energy update, and coincident damage event remains canonical and visible. Only rDPS transfer is exactly zero.
